strict_scoring.owner_rule: Each scored owner earns independent partial credit. Additional credit is available only for the published local business dependencies. A repeated consequence of one root error remains charged to its originating owner.

numeric_criteria.criterion: Complete supplied-run summary and evidence-bounded structured scope.
Fixed pre-cutoff population, degrees, sample SD, pooled variance and control limits.
Inverse calibration, width-scale uncertainty and simultaneous Sidak limit.
Every mass and optical record, daily decision and exception-register metric.
Monitoring mean, SD, shift and above-baseline count.
Baseline execution, row and column reordering, spaced paths and BOM input.
Recalculation after changed measurements and record identifiers.
Stable recalculation for a small valid tail probability.
Independent rejection of the published invalid-input classes without success files.

diagnostic_criteria.criterion: Recalculation at the documented alpha=0.001 diagnostic setting.
Installed declared dependencies and executable README commands.

semantic_criteria.criterion: Judge the supported decision chain, not a matching exception list alone: historical baseline signals require investigation, monitoring signals require valid repeat-run review, and any failed optical control propagates to all linked work for that day. Distinguish metric, run, reference-group and unknown customer-work counts. Correct alternative wording and organization are acceptable.

Trace supplied raw observations through the fixed pre-cutoff population, sample SD, degrees-weighted residual variance, correct F tail, inverse calibration and simultaneous reference-group limit to the reported exceptions. The actual 99/297 reconstruction is separate from the unexplained legacy 117/351; neither missing records nor a reconciled historical population may be invented. Mathematically equivalent calculations and explicit sign conventions are acceptable when converted to the public output convention. Do not substitute a source narrative's violation count for independently reconstructed supplied-data results.

Give reproducible offline use and explain the distinction between a fixed retrospective calculation and validated operational control. Retaining a baseline signal is not proof of baseline stability, and mostly passing individual values do not negate the observed process shift. Interpret linear-range and family-group claims within their evidence; do not require a textbook checklist or exact Golden prose. Alternative defensible follow-up and monitoring strategies are acceptable when the required fixed-baseline results remain identifiable.

Keep statistical loss of control separate from customer-product nonconformity. Missing workload links, specifications, uncertainty/decision rules and completed repeats prevent a customer count, release verdict or historical closure. Later passing days and partial linkage cannot clear earlier affected work. Identify usable follow-up records and valid repeat/authorization evidence. Apply deductions to the originating unsupported business inference, not repeatedly to every downstream restatement of one numerical slip.

local_dependencies: A complete baseline review requires correct reconstruction, source-supported explanation, operational limitations and bounded downstream scope.
A complete optical impact decision requires correct optical limits, record and day decisions, a supported action and bounded downstream scope.
A monitoring-shift interpretation requires correct trend calculations, a supported review action and appropriate operational limitations.
A rerunnable calculation requires representation invariance, changed-record and changed-setting responsiveness, and invalid-input rejection.
A supported summary requires correct structured summary and scope, source-supported conclusions and bounded claims.
Operational validation and closure claims require both stated limitations and evidence-bounded scope.

lenient_completion.rule: Every listed core decision must pass independently. Continuous strict score, tail diagnostics and usage diagnostics do not substitute for a missing core decision.

measurement_status.measured_failure: Missing, incorrect or unsupported candidate work receives the measured partial or zero result defined above.
measurement_status.unmeasured: Missing trusted inputs, failed isolation bootstrap, unavailable semantic service without a bound replay, malformed service protocol or other evaluator infrastructure failure produces UNMEASURED and publishes no stale reward.

minimum_usability.rule: One deduction applies when any minimum-usability decision fails; multiple symptoms of the same unusable delivery do not repeat it.

rules: All file names, CLI switches, result fields, status codes and invalid-input behavior are published in the instruction and measurement-interface.json.
Required fields, record membership, decisions and exception rows are independently reconstructed from the issued records and settings.
Equivalent output order, identifier formatting, algebra and source-correct wording receive credit.
One record may fail two metrics and several controls may identify one affected day; these counts are not interchangeable.
Unsupported configured methods and mixed systems must be rejected rather than silently pooled or substituted.
A scalar or CSV error recurring in fresh executions remains charged to its submitted-output owner; a variant owner fails only for an additional defect exposed by that variant.

A numerical error is not multiplied into several semantic deductions merely because the same value appears in several summaries. An independently unsupported customer action or closure claim is a separate business error.
A reference conflict with original material withholds semantic measurement instead of penalizing a source-correct submission.
